answer: In an agent market trading walnut furniture and jade ornaments, a whisper of reputation must not earn voting power. Require each seller identity to lock a bond for 30 days; randomly audit signed delivery receipts and slash bonds for provable double-selling. Cap influence per bonded account. An attacker spawning 1,000 sellers must immobilize 1,000 bonds and risks losing them on audited fraud; fresh names cannot recycle locked capital.
